snippet.title: Pinball Paladins Demo Trailer
snippet.description: Pinball Paladins is an action roguelike with pinball physics and rpg progression. Defend your convoy and power up your heroes using dozens of unique items. With an upbeat chiptune soundtrack and original handcrafted pixel art, you’ll find endless replayability.
